decisionsTitle: The clock stops while the door is shut: a window the site cannot be reached moves the deadlines that ran in it
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-03:** «DO IT! Make it super safe!». That day the registrar held the club's domain for about seven hours for its contact verification. The site, the backoffice, QA and the email subdomain could not be reached by name; the two pingers (the external monitors and the GitHub backstop) call the public name, so no job ran, while every participant's deadline kept running. Nobody lost a place only because no sweep ran before the name came back: the next run would have expired every address link, offer and invitation that lapsed while nobody could open the page that acts on it.

**Decision: the clock stops while the door is shut.** The registration maintenance job's first step, on every real run and before anything lapses (`registrations/door-shut.ts`, rules in `jobs/domain/door-shut.ts`), looks at the door two ways and keeps what it sees in one table, `door_shut_windows` (migration `0128_door_shut_windows`, expand only: the table and two `ADD VALUE`s):

- **The pings.** Every call of either job is already remembered in the data cache (§334), answered from the cache or run for real. The run reads the remembered calls since the job's previous real run (`readPingHistory`) and finds every silence longer than the pinger's own threshold — `jobStalenessThresholdMs`, twice the cadence plus five minutes, the very number `/api/health` pages on (35 minutes by day on production, 125 at night); no second threshold. A silence is a window from the call that should have come (the last one plus the cadence, `gap − cadence`) to the first that came, judged with the larger threshold and cadence of its two ends, so a stretch across 23:00 is read as the night would. Only QA and production, which have a pinger, are judged; a real run of either job inside a silence is a call that arrived; and a cache that has lost the previous real run's own ping slot (evicted, unreachable, outside a request) is not read at all — a silence read from it would be the cache's, not the pinger's. Missing never opens a window. A window seen this way is over when it is seen, so it can be detected late — at the run that the first deadline due after it, or the 04:00 window, brings — and still moves what it must.
- **The name.** The job resolves `APP_BASE_URL`'s host (`resilience/name-probe.ts`: one system lookup, two seconds at most, never throwing). Only «no such name» (`ENOTFOUND`, `ENODATA`) is `unresolved` — a registrar's hold takes the domain out of its zone; a timeout or a failed resolver is `unknown` and opens and closes nothing; a laptop, a test, an address that is a number or a private name is `skipped`. Reached by another address while the name is gone, the run opens a window (from the silence that ends at this run, if there is one, else now) and keeps it open until the name answers again. The probe runs in the job and the deep health only — never the shallow health (§577: it asks nobody) and never a page or an action a visitor waits on.

**While a window is open nothing lapses**: the run skips the address-link lapse (`expireStalePendingEmailConfirmations`), the family purges, every event's queue work (`fillAvailableSpots` and its `expireStaleHolds`, the invitations' lapse with it) and the verification resends (§653), whose link would open the name that is gone. Beyond the club's cap the window no longer holds them: the clock runs again, as the cap says.

**Once it is over, every deadline still running at its start moves later by its length** — the stop — capped by a new «Termene» number, «Ceasul termenelor stă pe loc cât site-ul nu se poate deschide, cel mult (ore)» (`doorShutMaxHours`, 0–168, 48 by default, 0 switches it off). The rules (`movedDeadline`):
- a deadline that passed at or before the window started never moves — the door was open then;
- later, never earlier, by the stop alone, then capped as the allocator caps it: a declaration hold, an offer, a family's reservation and a sitting's held place by the close and the start (`capHoldExpiry`), an invitation by the start alone (§647); a link is not capped by the event, as it never was (§513);
- a move that would still leave the deadline behind the run writes nothing.

What moves: per event, under its lock (`lockEventForCapacity`), one transaction each, compare-and-set on the value read — `registrations.hold_expires_at` of `PENDING_DECLARATION`, `WAITLIST_OFFERED` and a family's reserving `PENDING_EMAIL_CONFIRMATION`, `family_place_holds.expires_at`, and open `event_invitations.expires_at` (the one move of an invitation's deadline while somebody waits, AGENTS.md §10.6 amended: the clock stopped for the line too); event-blind, in one transaction, the address links (`email_link_expires_at`), the family's kept forms and its open sittings' links, and the live tokens of the links that end with them (`VERIFY_REGISTRATION_EMAIL`, `WAITLIST_OFFER`, `REGISTER_ANOTHER_PERSON`, `ACCEPT_INVITATION`), so the email's button still opens what the move kept. A cancelled or completed event is left as it is (§331, §82). Each moved registration gets the audit row `registration.deadline_moved_while_shut` (no actor; which deadline, from, to, the window's id), each invitation `event.invitation_deadline_moved_while_shut`. The window remembers the events it finished and its links (`events_moved`, `links_moved_at`), each written in the transaction that did the work, so a retried run does neither twice; a window whose moves fail keeps the sweeps held for two hours at most and is counted as a retryable error on every run.

**No overbooking, ever (AGENTS.md §10.6).** A move revives a deadline that passed while the door was shut — and an offer, a reservation, a held place or an invitation occupies its place again only once its deadline is ahead. Its place may have been given meanwhile: every read treats a lapsed offer as free, and the name may have answered a visitor before the run. So under the same lock, after moving what never lapsed (which changes no count), each revived claim is moved alone, oldest deadline first, and the places counted again with the allocator's own count (`countOccupied` → `computeOccupied`). One that takes the count past the capacity is put on «Lista de invitați speciali» (`outside_capacity`, §643, §648) in that transaction rather than counted — the registration's own audit row `registration.outside_capacity_changed` with no actor and the window's id, or the invitation's flag in its move's row — so nobody loses a place to the outage and no counted place is given twice. A family's held place has no row to seat: it is left to lapse, as it would have. Only rows that run moved are ever marked; a declaration hold is counted by its state whatever its deadline (§160) and is never marked. An offer revived this way is the one offer on the list: it lapses at its moved deadline like any other and frees no counted place.

**The Administrators are told twice, on the club's road.** `DOOR_SHUT` — «Site-ul nu se găsește după nume: termenele stau pe loc» — when a window opens on the name, and `DOOR_SHUT_DEADLINES_MOVED` — «Ceasul termenelor a stat pe loc: termenele s-au mutat» — once its deadlines have moved: once per window each (`door-shut:<window>:<shut|moved>:<staff id>`), to every Administrator and Superadministrator with an address, in their language, no participant, no token. Both take the `club` group (Gmail by default since §622), which does not hang on the club's own domain — the thing that may be gone when the first one leaves. The window's instants, its stop, the cap and the counts are the bold line; the paragraphs are the platform's sentences alone, so a club's own wording of them (§359) never stores a date or a count. The first has no button (the address it would open is the one that is gone); the second opens «Sarcini». Participants are emailed nothing: the new deadline is on their own page and in each registration's history.

**Where it shows.** `/api/health?deep=1` gains a `door` block — `name` (`resolves`, `unresolved`, `unknown`, `skipped`), `shutSince`, `lastWindow`, instants only, no counts — and answers `degraded` while the name is `unresolved` or a window is open, so a monitor that calls by another address hears it; the probe is bounded like the deep check's other third parties. `/devs` → Stare has the line «Ceasul termenelor» (none, open since, or the latest window with its stop and counts), read from the table. «Sarcini» has the row «Site-ul de negăsit: ceasul termenelor» (`doorShut`, a check, the club's): red while a window is open, open for seven days after one is over with what moved and how many were seated on the list, green otherwise. The maintenance job's answer carries `door`.

**Refused.**
- **A second threshold for a silence**, or a lower one: a false window moves every deadline; the threshold that pages the owner is the one the platform already trusts.
- **Moving only the deadlines that lapsed in the window**: a deadline still ahead lost the same hours of a door nobody could open; the clock stops for everybody.
- **Reviving onto a place somebody else now holds** (two people told «the place is yours» for one place), and **leaving the revived claim lapsed**: the outage would decide who loses. The list seats the claim beyond the advertised places, in the open and audited.
- **Probing the name on a page or in the shallow health**: a lookup on every request and every hourly monitor call, for an answer the job already keeps.
- **Treating a resolver's timeout as a shut door**: a slow resolver would hold every sweep.
- **Emailing the participants**: one email per moved deadline is a mailer; the page states the deadline.

**Open for the owner.** A silence of the pinger alone (the monitors' own service down while the site answered) is read as a shut door too: the deadlines then move although a visitor could have acted — generous to the participants, a few hours' wait for the waiting list. A participation window's hold (§104) already after the close is never moved, as the cap by the close says.
changelogLine: - **The clock stops while the site cannot be reached** — when the site's name stops resolving, or no scheduled call reaches the platform for longer than the monitors allow, nothing lapses until it is back; then every participant's deadline that was running moves later by as long as it lasted, at most the new «Termene» number (48 hours by default). A place given away meanwhile is not taken back: the person is seated on «Lista de invitați speciali». The Administrators are emailed when it starts and what moved; `/api/health`, `/devs` and «Sarcini» show it. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given a deployment with a pinger and a silence of every job's calls longer than the pinger's threshold (`jobStalenessThresholdMs`: 35 minutes by day, 125 at night), when the maintenance job next runs for real, then it records a window from the last call plus the cadence to the first call after the silence and, before any lapse of that run, moves every address link, declaration hold, offer, family reservation, family held place, invitation and their live link tokens whose deadline was after the window's start later by the window's length, capped by «Termene»'s `doorShutMaxHours` and as the allocator caps it, compare-and-set, each moved registration audited with no actor; a deadline at or before the window's start, a move still behind the run, a cancelled or completed event, a cache that no longer shows the previous run's own ping, a real run of either job inside the silence, and `doorShutMaxHours` 0 move nothing; a retried run moves nothing twice (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the job reached while the site's public name answers «no such name», then it opens one window, lapses no link, hold, offer, invitation or family form and re-sends no verification email until the name answers again, and then moves the deadlines by the window's length as above; a resolver that times out or fails opens and closes nothing; the name is asked by the maintenance job and the deep health only, never by the shallow health or a page (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a revived offer, reservation or invitation whose counted place was given while the door was shut, when the move revives it under the event lock, then it is seated «În afara locurilor» (`outside_capacity`) in that transaction with an audit row and no actor, so `computeOccupied` never exceeds the capacity; a family's held place with no room is left lapsed; only rows the move touched are marked (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a window opened on the name, then `DOOR_SHUT` is queued once to every Administrator and Superadministrator with an address, and given a window whose deadlines moved, `DOOR_SHUT_DEADLINES_MOVED` is queued once to the same people: no participant, no token, the `club` road, the window's instants, stop and counts on the bold line and the platform's sentences alone in the paragraphs, each under 200 characters in both languages (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the door's windows, then `/api/health?deep=1` carries `door` (`name`, `shutSince`, `lastWindow`, instants only) and answers `degraded` while the name is `unresolved` or a window is open, `/devs` says the latest window, and «Sarcini» carries the row `doorShut` — red while shut, open for seven days after a window, green otherwise (2026-10-03, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: the clock stops while the site cannot be reached: nothing lapses, then the deadlines move by the outage
